name: Model 14 vibrospear
description: The Model 14 vibrospear, sometimes known as the "Stalker," was a two-meter-long plasteel vibrospear that was designed for hunting large animals. The two-handed weapon was created by Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc. in response to LaserHone's Huntsman vibrospear, and although it was cheaper, it was much noisier, meaning that prey could be alerted by its vibrations.
